name: Dua-e-Yunus
short_desc: This hand-painted acrylic artwork features Dua-e-Yunus elegantly draped over a serene mosque dome motif. The background showcases an expressive, watercolor-style fusion of royal blue, vibrant magenta, and golden yellow, beautifully complemented by fluid calligraphy in silver, white, and metallic gold accents. Completed with a protective gloss varnish seal, this spiritual piece brings tranquility and grace to any prayer room, bedroom, or quiet corner.
seo_title: Hand-Painted Acrylic Mosque Dome Wall Decor – Dua-e-Yunus Calligraphy with Varnish Finish
description:
Bring spiritual serenity, grace, and expressive beauty into your living space with this captivating hand-painted Islamic calligraphy masterpiece. The artwork beautifully features the powerful Dua-e-Yunus (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimin) gracefully draped over a majestic mosque dome motif.

Crafted using high-grade acrylic paints, this artwork displays a rich, watercolor-inspired wash background featuring a stunning fusion of royal blue, vibrant magenta, and golden yellow hues. The elegant Arabic calligraphy flows seamlessly in striking silver and white script, while delicate gold accents outline the dome's architectural details, adding depth and luminous warmth.

To preserve its artistic beauty and guarantee durability, the painting is finished with a protective gloss varnish seal. This varnish layer guards the acrylic paints against dust, moisture, and fading over time while enhancing the vibrancy of the colors under ambient light.

Enclosed in an elegant frame, this spiritual artwork serves as an enchanting centerpiece for prayer nooks, bedrooms, living rooms, or peaceful study spaces. It perfectly blends sacred Islamic heritage with modern abstract expressionism.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish finish for enhanced color depth and longevity

Theme & Script: Dua-e-Yunus with an architectural mosque dome silhouette

Color Palette: Royal blue, vibrant magenta, and golden yellow background, accented with silver, white, and gold calligraphy

Style: Modern Expressive / Architectural Islamic Art Fusion

Ideal Placement: Prayer room, lounge, bedroom, or quiet study nook
